commonConditions.symptoms: Swelling, heat and tenderness in udder, milk appears clotted or watery with blood flakes.
commonConditions.firstAid: Empty affected quarter gently; cold compress on swollen udder; avoid milking onto floor.
commonConditions.prevention: Post-milking teat dipping in 0.5% povidone-iodine; maintain clean dry stall bedding.
commonConditions.vetUrgency: High (Administer intramammary antibiotics under qualified veterinary guidance within 12 hours).

commonConditions.disease: Foot and Mouth Disease - FMD (கோமாரி நோய்)
commonConditions.symptoms: High fever, excessive frothy salivation, blisters on tongue, dental pad and interdigital cleft of feet.
commonConditions.firstAid: Wash mouth with 1% potassium permanganate or sodium bicarbonate solution; apply boro-glycerine to ulcers.
commonConditions.prevention: Bi-annual vaccination under TN Animal Husbandry FMD-CP schedule (March & September).
commonConditions.vetUrgency: Urgent Emergency (Report immediately to local Veterinary Dispensary or dial 1962).

commonConditions.symptoms: Sudden swelling of left flank, restless behavior, rapid breathing and kicking at belly.
commonConditions.firstAid: Keep animal standing with front quarters elevated; drench with 500ml edible groundnut/gingerly oil with 30ml turpentine oil.
commonConditions.prevention: Avoid sudden feeding of lush leguminous green fodder (Lucerne/Berseem) without dry roughage.

commonConditions.disease: Peste des Petits Ruminants - PPR (ஆட்டுக்கொள்ளை நோய்)
commonConditions.symptoms: Sudden high fever, discharges from eyes and nose, necrotic lesions in mouth, profuse watery diarrhea.
commonConditions.firstAid: Isolate sick goats; administer oral electrolyte fluids to combat dehydration; feed soft gruel.
commonConditions.prevention: PPR vaccination gives immunity for 3 years; vaccinate all kids above 3 months.

commonConditions.symptoms: Sudden death in fast-growing lambs, neurological staggering, convulsions before death.
commonConditions.firstAid: Immediate veterinary drenching with anti-toxin serum.
commonConditions.prevention: Vaccinate with ET vaccine 15 days before onset of monsoon rains.
